author: Espinosa & Ortea, 1999

note.en: A tiny marginella shell, under 1 cm long, that lives on sand and rubble. Known here from 7 museum specimen records (Gandoca-Manzanillo refuge, Manzanillo, Punta Mona, Cahuita, 1999 to 2003).
note.es: Una concha marginela diminuta, de menos de 1 cm, que vive en arena y escombro. Conocido aquí por 7 registros de ejemplares de museo (Gandoca-Manzanillo refugio, Manzanillo, Punta Mona, Cahuita, 1999 a 2003).

evidence: GBIF: 7 specimen records in the region (Gandoca-Manzanillo refuge, Manzanillo, Punta Mona, Cahuita, 1999 to 2003)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Museum specimens from Gandoca-Manzanillo refuge, Manzanillo, Punta Mona, Cahuita.
